name: veeva-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Veeva Products.

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: For any user working with a live Vault: signing in with SSO, an API access token, or a username and password, and retrieving data with VQL queries.

plugins.name: vault-developer
plugins.description: For developers using code to extend, customize, or integrate with Vault: the Vault API, Java SDK, Custom Pages, and Vault AI Agents.

plugins.name: vault-administrator
plugins.description: For administrators working in a live Vault: pulling the Vault's configuration to disk, moving files through Vault File Staging, scripting configuration changes with MDL, explaining and drafting reports, dashboards and Process Monitor views, drafting Vault AI metadata, and moving configuration and code between Vaults as packages. Signs in through the vault plugin's login skill.
